name: Circular Text
description: Text laid out around a circle that spins continuously, reacts to hover with speed changes, and can be dragged and flung. Supports a ring outline, 3D tilt, and centered children.
contents: Circular container with each letter placed around the circle
Optional ring outline inside the letters
Optional centered children slot for an icon or image
behavior: Letters rotate continuously around the center, paused while offscreen
Hover changes spin speed (slow down, speed up, pause, or go bonkers with shrink)
Optional drag to spin with release fling momentum
Optional hover tilt in 3D following the pointer
Letters ease into position after mount
Spinning and hover effects are disabled with reduced motion
editableByProps: Text, size, font size, weight, letter spacing and color
Spin speed, direction and hover reaction
Spread across full circle or natural spacing, repeat count, start angle
Ring outline and its color, static tilt, hover tilt, drag interaction

needsCodeEdit.change: Change maximum fling speed after drag
Change letter settle animation easing or duration
Change spring feel of hover speed, scale and tilt
needsCodeEdit.where: useSpring calls for speed, scale, tiltX and tiltY

fixed: Text is required, nothing renders without it
Centered horizontally with mx-auto and always a circle of size by size
Cursor is a pointer unless draggable, which uses grab cursors and disables touch scrolling on it
Pauses spinning when offscreen using IntersectionObserver
Drag scales the circle to 0.96 and goBonkers hover scales it to 0.8
Text is exposed as a single img with aria-label
